description: This file contains an object 'AstronomicalCalculator' which provides utility functions for astronomical calculations related to the sun's position, sunrise, and sunset times based on date and location.

classes.name: SunPosition
classes.description: Data class representing sunrise and sunset times as strings.

methods.name: calculateSunPosition
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sunrise and sunset times for a given date and geographical coordinates.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Helper method to format decimal hours into HH:MM string.
